Subject: AWS ACE: FinOptics marketplace listing prep & PDM/PSM coordination

Sarah —

Thanks for taking our initial inbound on FinOptics. They are evaluating Redwood for a high-throughput inference use case (search relevancy + embeddings) and are interested in an AWS co-sell + marketplace listing. Quick context: FinOptics is a Series B analytics vendor, expected ARR ~ $180k in year 1, procurement timeline Q3. Lisa (CC) is the buyer.

Can you confirm next steps to register this opportunity in ACE and the information you need from us / FinOptics to move forward? I attached a short opportunity brief and a filled ACE intake sheet to speed things up.

Key asks from our side:
- ACE registration with AWS (please assign a case number)
- Intro to the AWS PDM and PSM who will own the co-sell relationship
- Marketplace listing checklist + estimated lead time for listing (is a 4–6 week target realistic?)

Tentative timeline we have in mind: ACE registration this week, PDM/PSM intro early next week, marketplace listing kickoff by 3/15.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the context and the attachments, that was helpful. I’ve started the ACE intake and created case #ACE-20280303-12345. A few quick items I still need to complete registration:
- FinOptics AWS account ID (or the AWS partner account to associate)
- Primary business contact (we have Lisa; can you confirm phone and billing contact?)
- Estimated logo / listing assets owner (who will provide marketing copy + icon)

I’ll loop in the PDM/PSM once the intake is in the system — Michael Chen (PDM) will likely be the right point but we’ll confirm. For marketplace listing timing: 4–6 weeks is possible but depends on the completeness of the listing artifacts and security review.

I’ve attached the ACE case stub and a link to the listing checklist below.

—Sarah

Thanks for the note and for completing the intake. I’m Michael (PDM) — happy to be involved. I can join a 30-min sync on Thursday 3/9 or Friday 3/10 US-PST; please share availabilities and I’ll block.

To prepare for the meeting, please bring the following:
- Final ACE intake form (completed)
- FinOptics contact and billing info + anticipated procurement route (marketplace vs. direct)
- Listing assets: short description (150–300 words), 1–2 screenshots, icon (512x512 PNG)
- Any security attestation (SOC2 or questionnaire responses) — our security review is typically light for listings but we need the basics.

Happy to drive the AWS side of the co-sell once the ACE case is confirmed. I’ll follow up with calendar invites after we pick a slot.
